NEWS 2026-11-18 Vice (GTA 6 Has One Man Booking a Weeklong Vacation From His Own Marriage):
Everyone needs time to themselves every once in a while. Booking a solo hotel room is one good way to do that, and it allows someone to decompress, to starfish on a big bed and watch TV, and…play GTA 6 with minimal interruptions. One gamer took that idea and ran with it, booking a hotel room for himself right before the game became available worldwide on November 19.
One week in a hotel room Alone to play gta 6
As noted on Instagram, one Reddit user took to the “GTA6unmoderated” sub to share his plans for the nail-bitingly close U.S. release of the game. The title of the post simply reads, “I’ve rented a hotel room for a week so nobody can bother me”. The post itself features a picture of the gamer standing in front of a TV featuring the GTA 6 background, with the gamer himself grinning while GTA 6 stars Jason and Lucia pose seriously on the screen behind him.
Videos by VICE
There is definitely a wide range of reactions in the comments, although some is just silly banter. One user leaned into a long-running joke: “We’ve got this guy booking a hotel room for GTA6 before we got GTA6.” Another comment simply featured a GIF of Chris Evans as Captain America, saluting the camera.
This gamer definitely isn’t the only one who is making plans based on his excitement around the game. In fact, back in October, there were concerns that so many people would put in PTO or simply call in sick to work that it would actually impact the U.S. economy. It was estimated at the time that 1.5 million people might miss work that day, with some companies even building the release date into their time-off package.
Now that the wait is so very close to being over – or is already over, depending on timezones – gamers will soon be able to turn on their console of choice and finally see GTA 6 ready to play. Whether they take the day off, book a hotel room, or wait until they get home from work, one thing is clear.
The streets of Vice City are about to become very busy.

NEWS 2026-11-18 Good Morning America · via Yahoo Tech (GTA 6 comes out this week: Release time, reviews, preloading, file size and more):
The arrival of the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) is imminent, with the release date set for this Thursday, Nov. 19.
Publisher Rockstar Games has been teasing fans with details about the sixth numbered entry in the massively popular video game franchise for years.
When is Grand Theft Auto VI coming out?
GTA 6, which is available to pre-order now, will release on Thursday for Sony PlayStation 5 and Microsoft Xbox Series X|S.
People who've preordered can preload it onto their console so it's ready to play at midnight local time on Thursday. You'll need at least 210 GB of free space on your console, so you might have to delete some other games.
What time will it be released?
The game will be playable at midnight in your time zone.
What is the game about?
Each GTA game takes place in different heavily hyperbolic versions of American cities, and focuses on characters working their way through the city's world of crime.
GTA 6 will take place in Vice City and Leonida -- inspired by Miami and Florida -- and follow Bonnie and Clyde-style criminal duo Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Lucia is the series' first female protagonist.
"Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them," a brief synopsis of the game reads. "But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida -- forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive."
What can I do in the game?
GTA 6 is a third-person action-adventure game that allows players to explore a massive, detailed open world on foot and in a wide array of vehicles.
You can undertake specific missions (which typically involve some kind of criminal activity), explore the city and its surroundings, engage in a wider array of activities (including skydiving and wrestling) and take on law enforcement (who will call reinforcements as the situation escalates).
This freedom is central to the series' appeal. Players can do what they like rather than stick to a linear path. Each gameplay session can be tailored to your mood; you might follow the story, play some mini games, wander the game world or cause chaos the next
"I think that's a very escapist fantasy for a lot of people that the game really gives them a lot of ownership over," Bloomberg video game reporter Cecilia D'Anastasio told "GMA" on Friday.
You can play as Jason and Lucia, each of whom has a customizable appearance.
Are GTA 6 reviews out?
The review embargo broke on Wednesday, and GTA 6 has been met with universal acclaim from critics:
IGN: 10/10
GameSpot: 10/10
Game Informer: 10/10
Eurogamer: 5/5
GamesRadar: 5/5

The current GTA 6 release date is November 19, 2026.
That is the date Rockstar and Take-Two now list for Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It is also the date attached to preorders, preload timing and the latest official launch material.
The simple answer is easy. The history is messier. GTA 6 started as a 2025 game, was later moved to May 26, 2026, then moved again to November 19, 2026. That makes the release date one of the most important things to track during the final stretch of the rollout.
This page follows the official timeline only: Rockstar, Take-Two, store listings and published trailer beats. Rumours, retail placeholders and leaked dates do not count unless Rockstar or Take-Two confirms them.
GTA 6 release date quick facts
- Current release date: November 19, 2026
- Launch platforms: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S
- PC release date: not announced
- Original release window: 2025
- Previous full date: May 26, 2026
- Preorders opened: June 25, 2026
- Digital preload: available since November 10, 2026
- Code-in-box retail availability: from November 12, 2026, with a download code rather than a game disc
For the wider picture around characters, Leonida, trailers, platforms and preorders, start with our GTA 6 everything we know feature. This page is just the release-date record.
GTA 6 release date history
| Date | Official timing | What changed | 
|---|---|---|
| December 4, 2023 | 2025 | Rockstar and Take-Two announced GTA 6 for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S with Trailer 1 and a broad 2025 window. | 
| May 2, 2025 | May 26, 2026 | Take-Two said the game, previously expected in Fall 2025, was now planned for May 26, 2026. | 
| May 6, 2025 | May 26, 2026 | Trailer 2 arrived and Take-Two again described GTA 6 as set to launch May 26, 2026. | 
| November 6, 2025 | November 19, 2026 | Take-Two announced that GTA 6 was now launching November 19, 2026. | 
| June 24-25, 2026 | November 19, 2026 | Rockstar announced preorder timing and launch details, again listing November 19, 2026 as the release date. | 
| August 27, 2026 | November 19, 2026 | Rockstar released GTA VI: An Extended Look and again listed November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X\ | 
| October 15, 2026 | November 19, 2026 | Rockstar released the GTA VI launch trailer and again said the game would arrive November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X\ | 
| November 10, 2026 | November 19, 2026 | Rockstar opened digital preloading for players who preordered on PS5 and Xbox Series X\ | 
That is the official chain so far. GTA 6 went from a broad 2025 window, to a full May 2026 date, to the current November 2026 date.
The current date is November 19, 2026
November 19, 2026 is the date that matters now.
Rockstar's GTA VI site, Take-Two's preorder announcement and the store campaign all point to that date. Rockstar repeated it when the GTA 6 Extended Look went live on August 27, then reaffirmed it with the launch trailer on October 15. It is not a rumour, not a retailer placeholder and not a leaked target. It is the active official date.
The date also sits at the centre of the current buying timeline. Preorders opened in June 2026. Digital preload is now available for players who have preordered: it went live at midnight local time on PlayStation 5 and 12 a.m. GMT worldwide on Xbox Series X|S on November 10. Rockstar says code-in-box versions should be available from retailers beginning November 12, with a download code rather than a game disc.

GTA 6 is almost here. The next Grand Theft Auto is arguably the most anticipated game of all time, and we're now just hours away from returning to Vice City.
I remember being there for the midnight launch of GTA 4, and booking the day off work to play GTA 5, but nothing comes close to the sky-high excitement surrounding GTA 6. If you can't wait to play it and you're wondering when does GTA 6 come out, then we've rounded up everything you need to know. We've got details on the GTA 6 release time and the New Zealand trick, plus much more.
On this page:
GTA 6 release time and date
Rockstar Games has confirmed that GTA 6 will launch at midnight local time on Thursday 19th, November 2026. Unlike some games which launch at different times in regions around the world, the Grand Theft Auto makers said they had adopted "a rolling midnight launch by country". So you'll just need to wait for 12am on release day for the game to unlock in your region on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
There are a few caveats to all this. Due to the way the game is being rolled out, GTA 6 will launch in some countries earlier than others. It will be playable in New Zealand first, with gamers there getting to play it six hours ahead of those on the US East Coast, and for half a day before GTA 6 hits Europe.
If you want to go into GTA 6 without any spoilers, just be aware there will be people that have a headstart.
Is there GTA 6 early access?
GTA 6 doesn't have early access, so there is no official way you can play it early. Due to the way the game is being rolled out, you may be wondering if you'll be able to play GTA 6 early if you change your console's settings so it looks like you're in New Zealand. It is a method that has worked with other high-profile launches. If this is something you're considering, we've got this guide on the GTA 6 New Zealand trick to help you out.
GTA 6 free codes giveaway
If you haven't purchased GTA 6 yet, you can save some money thanks to Twitch and Kick. The streaming giants will be giving away free GTA 6 codes at launch to viewers. Kick alone is giving away 10,000 GTA 6 codes, while Twitch said they will be doing daily code drops from launch till the end of November. Of course, getting a GTA 6 code via this way isn't guaranteed, and you could simply get some of the other freebies that are available. If this sounds like something you want to try out, check out our page on how to get free GTA 6 codes from Twitch and Kick launch streams.
How to preload GTA 6
The GTA 6 preload began last week. To preload GTA 6, you need to have pre-ordered the game ahead of launch. Whether you pre-ordered digitally or physically, you will be able to install the game to your PS5 or Xbox Series X|S right now. That's because the physical version just comes with a code in a box, and it began shipping prior to the game's release date.
If you already pre-ordered digitally, you'll just need to go to the GTA 6 listing on the PlayStation Store or your Xbox's store and choose to install the game. If you bought the physical version instead, you'll need to redeem the code you received first.
It's best to get ready and preload GTA 6 now if you want to jump into Vice City as soon as the game unlocks. You may also need to free up some space on your console, given how hefty the file size is.
